A [[Snivvian]] '''bartender''' operated in the [[The Pilots' Rest]] in [[Adelphi Base]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="Chapter 21" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A Snivvian [[bartender]] first appeared, albeit unidentified, in the fifth episode of the [[The Mandalorian Season Three|third season]] of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', "[[Chapter 21: The Pirate]]"<ref name="Chapter 21" /> which was released on [[March 29]], [[2023]].<ref name="D23 March">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-march-2023|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in March 2023}}</ref> The character was portrayed by actress and stuntwoman, [[Misty Rosas]].<ref name="Chapter 21" /> 

====Name identification====
Within a [[StarWars.com]] article released on [[October 11]], [[2025]], promoting upcoming publications from [[Lucasfilm|Lucasfilm Publishing]] initially announced at New York Comic Con, the character was first identified as "Ankeefo" in one of the preliminary preview spread pages under the [[Adelphi]] section for the upcoming [[2026]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian Visual Guide]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and published by [[Dorling Kindersley]].<ref name="NYCC 2025">{{SW|url=news/nycc-2025-lucasfilm-publishing-reveals|text=NYCC 2025: All the News and Reveals from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}}</ref> Subsequently however, within the finalized preview spread pages released on the Amazon and [[Wikipedia:Penguin Random House|Penguin Random House]] websites, the name was altered to a general title, "Snivvian Bartender", prescribing the unidentified character's species and occupation.<ref name="DK">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/807011/star-wars-the-mandalorian-visual-guide-by-pablo-hidalgo|text=Star Wars The Mandalorian Visual Guide}}</ref>
